opening.argument: The video directs viewers to join BitConnect, calling it “a very profitable investment program,” while describing a lending arrangement in which viewers give Bitcoin to the program and buy its tokens. It further presents giving BitConnect money as producing payment every day, reports daily percentage returns, and says the only required activity is to reinvest. The promotion also adds a staking program that allegedly pays participants simply for holding the coins. On screen, a BitConnect page displays credited-interest entries, an interest chart, and a projected-earning calculator, reinforcing the promised-return presentation. The speaker calls the system proven and points to friends who allegedly quit their jobs through involvement with it. Ordinary exchange and deposit interfaces may also appear, but the central message is an invitation to place Bitcoin or money into BitConnect for claimed recurring returns.
